weaknesses.name: Gullible
weaknesses.description: I trust everything people tell me.

weaknesses.name: Greedy
weaknesses.description: I always want a bigger share of all treasures.

weaknesses.name: Easily Offended
weaknesses.description: I never tolerate a provocation.

weaknesses.name: Foolhardy
weaknesses.description: I always go first when danger approaches.

weaknesses.name: Fearful
weaknesses.description: I always stay in the rear.

weaknesses.name: Monster Hater
weaknesses.description: All monsters are abominations that must be slain.

weaknesses.name: Intolerant
weaknesses.description: Night folk like orcs and dark elves are evil and must be fought.

weaknesses.name: Lazy
weaknesses.description: I take every chance to rest.

weaknesses.name: Foodie
weaknesses.description: I take every chance to eat something good.

weaknesses.name: Kleptomaniac
weaknesses.description: I can never resist stealing valuables.

weaknesses.name: Vain
weaknesses.description: I always help those who flatter me.

weaknesses.name: Daredevil
weaknesses.description: I always take big risks without considering consequences.

weaknesses.name: Arcanophobe
weaknesses.description: Magic is the force of evil and mages can never be trusted.

weaknesses.name: Bookworm
weaknesses.description: The pursuit of knowledge is more important than my friends.

weaknesses.name: Wild
weaknesses.description: I never sleep indoors.

weaknesses.name: Braggart
weaknesses.description: I always exaggerate my deeds.

weaknesses.name: Violent
weaknesses.description: I meet every setback with violence.

weaknesses.name: Know-It-All
weaknesses.description: I always tell others what they should do.

weaknesses.name: Pessimist
weaknesses.description: I see the world in black and never believe things will go well.

weaknesses.name: Haughty
weaknesses.description: I look down on everyone I meet.

heroicAbilities.name: Lightning fast
heroicAbilities.description: Draw two initiative cards and choose the best. Once per round.

heroicAbilities.name: Berserker
heroicAbilities.description: Become Angry. Advantage on all melee attacks but cannot parry or dodge. Must fight until all enemies defeated or you hit 0 HP. Become Exhausted after.

heroicAbilities.name: Defensive
heroicAbilities.description: Parry an attack without using your action. Can be used multiple times per round if WP allows.

heroicAbilities.name: Dragonslayer
heroicAbilities.description: Attack against a monster deals 1d8 extra damage. Activate after hitting, before rolling damage.

heroicAbilities.name: Double slash
heroicAbilities.description: Attack two enemies within 2m with one slash. Single attack roll, separate damage. Can combine with Dual wield.

heroicAbilities.name: Lone wolf
heroicAbilities.description: Long rest in wilderness without needing to roll Bushcraft for camp. Only affects yourself.

heroicAbilities.name: Eagle eye
heroicAbilities.description: See details at 200m as if close. Lasts 15 min. In combat, no disadvantage for shooting beyond effective range.

heroicAbilities.name: Focused
heroicAbilities.description: Max WP permanently increased by 2. Can be taken multiple times.

heroicAbilities.name: Companion
heroicAbilities.description: Make an animal your companion (takes 15 min). One companion at a time. It scouts for you. 3 extra WP for it to attack.

heroicAbilities.name: Disguise
heroicAbilities.description: After 15 min, mimic another person's appearance/voice/behavior. Same kin only. Those who know the person can roll Awareness within 10m.

heroicAbilities.name: Guardian
heroicAbilities.description: When you and allies are in melee with same enemy (within 2m) and enemy targets an ally, force the attack onto yourself. Not an action.

heroicAbilities.name: Master tanner
heroicAbilities.description: Requires leather tools. In one shift, craft leather armor from a creature's skin. Armor gets half the beast's protection value (rounded up, min 1). WP cost equals protection value.

heroicAbilities.name: Fast healer
heroicAbilities.description: Heal an extra 1d6 HP during a short rest. Does not affect WP or condition recovery.

heroicAbilities.name: Fast footwork
heroicAbilities.description: Dodge an attack without using your action. Can use multiple times per round if WP allows.

heroicAbilities.name: Insight
heroicAbilities.description: After talking with someone, roll Awareness to determine if they're lying.

heroicAbilities.name: Intuition
heroicAbilities.description: When facing a hard decision, ask the GM one question and get a useful answer.

heroicAbilities.name: Iron fist
heroicAbilities.description: Unarmed attack damage increases by 1d6. Activate as free action after hitting.

heroicAbilities.name: Iron grip
heroicAbilities.description: Advantage on Brawling to grab someone or resist breaking free.

heroicAbilities.name: Throwing arm
heroicAbilities.description: Throw a one-handed melee weapon at an enemy up to STR meters away. Normal attack roll.

heroicAbilities.name: Catlike
heroicAbilities.description: Reduce fall damage dice by 1 per WP spent. Can roll Acrobatics first, then activate.

heroicAbilities.name: Massive blow
heroicAbilities.description: Two-handed melee attack deals 1d8 extra damage. Cannot move in same round. Activate after hitting.

heroicAbilities.name: Quartermaster
heroicAbilities.description: Automatically succeed on Bushcraft to set up camp during expedition.

heroicAbilities.name: Assassin
heroicAbilities.description: Sneak attack deals 1d8 extra damage. Can combine with Backstabbing. Activate after hitting.

heroicAbilities.name: Magic School
heroicAbilities.description: Learn a new magic school (even if not a mage). Must train separately. Can take multiple times for different schools.

heroicAbilities.name: Monster Hunter
heroicAbilities.description: At a crossroads, learn which direction holds the most dangerous enemies.

heroicAbilities.name: Master spellcaster
heroicAbilities.description: At your turn, cast two different spells with one action. Can activate after first spell succeeds.

heroicAbilities.name: Master Chef
heroicAbilities.description: Automatically succeed at cooking without Bushcraft roll.

heroicAbilities.name: Master blacksmith
heroicAbilities.description: Requires smithing tools. Sharpen a weapon (3 WP, 15 min): armor counts as one step lower vs it. In one shift, craft any metal weapon or armor from the equipment lists. Requires anvil, forge, and iron.

heroicAbilities.name: Master Carpenter
heroicAbilities.description: Requires carpentry tools. As action: deal 1d12 damage per WP to door/wall/object (ignoring protection). In one shift, craft any wooden item from equipment lists.

heroicAbilities.name: Contortionist
heroicAbilities.description: Escape bonds or squeeze through narrow passages without a skill roll.

heroicAbilities.name: Fearless
heroicAbilities.description: Automatically resist fear without rolling WIL.

heroicAbilities.name: Deflect arrow
heroicAbilities.description: Parry a ranged attack with a melee weapon (no shield needed).

heroicAbilities.name: Sea Legs
heroicAbilities.description: Negate all negative effects of being in water for one round, including drowning risk.

heroicAbilities.name: Treasure Hunter
heroicAbilities.description: At a crossroads, learn which direction holds the greatest treasures.

heroicAbilities.name: Shield Block
heroicAbilities.description: Advantage on shield parry. Can also parry non-area monster attacks that normally cannot be parried.

heroicAbilities.name: Pathfinder
heroicAbilities.description: Automatically succeed on Bushcraft to find direction in wilderness.

heroicAbilities.name: Battle cry
heroicAbilities.description: As action in combat, all other PCs within earshot heal one condition. Combat only.

heroicAbilities.name: Veteran
heroicAbilities.description: Keep initiative card from previous round instead of drawing new one. Not an action.

heroicAbilities.name: Backstabbing
heroicAbilities.description: When attacking an enemy within 2m of another PC in melee, treat as sneak attack (cannot be dodged/parried, advantage, +1 damage die). Agile weapon only. Not an action.

heroicAbilities.name: Musician
heroicAbilities.description: As action, give all allies within 10m advantage on all rolls, OR give all enemies within 10m disadvantage. Lasts until your next turn.

heroicAbilities.name: Twin shot
heroicAbilities.description: Fire two arrows instead of one. Single attack roll with disadvantage. Separate damage. Can target same or different targets.

heroicAbilities.name: Dual wield
heroicAbilities.description: With one-handed weapon in each hand, make an extra attack with off-hand (STR requirement +3). Second attack has disadvantage. Can combine with Double Slash.

heroicAbilities.name: Robust
heroicAbilities.description: Max HP permanently increased by 2. Can be taken multiple times.

heroicAbilities.name: Weasel
heroicAbilities.description: When attacked with another PC within 2m, redirect attack to that PC. No effect on area attacks. Must use before dodge/parry.

heroicAbilities.name: Adaptive
heroicAbilities.description: When making a skill roll, you may choose to roll against a different skill instead. You must justify how the chosen skill applies. The GM has final say but should be permissive.

heroicAbilities.name: Hard to Catch
heroicAbilities.description: When dodging an attack, you get an advantage on your DODGE roll.

heroicAbilities.name: Unforgiving
heroicAbilities.description: When you attack someone who has previously damaged you (1+ HP), you get an advantage on the attack roll. Does not matter when the damage occurred.

heroicAbilities.name: Inner Peace
heroicAbilities.description: During a short rest, you meditate deeply. You heal an extra 1d6 HP and 1d6 WP, and recover from one extra condition. However, you are completely unreachable during meditation and cannot be awakened.

heroicAbilities.name: Ill-tempered
heroicAbilities.description: When making any roll, you get an advantage. You also become Angry (if not already). Cannot be used for INT or INT-based skill rolls.

heroicAbilities.name: Webbed Feet
heroicAbilities.description: You get advantage on all SWIM rolls and always move at full speed in or under water.

heroicAbilities.name: Hunting instincts
heroicAbilities.description: Designate a creature within line of sight, or whose scent trail you follow, as your quarry. This counts as an action in combat. You can follow the scent trail up to one day. You can spend 1 extra WP (not an action) to get advantage on an attack against the quarry.

rules.metalRestriction: Cannot cast while wearing metal armor or holding metal weapons
rules.spellBookRule: Required to prepare spells (formelbok). Losing it means you can only use currently prepared spells.

learningRules.fromTeacher: 1 shift training, then use improvement mark for magic school. Roll INT with advantage.
learningRules.fromSpellBook: Same as teacher but roll Languages (Främmande språk) instead of INT, no advantage.
learningRules.cantrips: 15 min from teacher or book, no roll needed.
learningRules.newSchool: Requires Magic School (Magisk talang) heroic ability + 1 week study with teacher. Roll INT at end.

cantrips.name: Fetch
cantrips.description: A loose object (no heavier than weight 1) within 10 meters floats to you.

cantrips.name: Flick
cantrips.description: Magically flick an object or creature within 10 meters for 1 point of damage. Can shatter glass objects.

cantrips.name: Sense Magic
cantrips.description: Determine whether a place you are in or an object you hold is affected by magic, and if so, what kind.

cantrips.name: Mend Clothes
cantrips.description: Your or someone else's clothes (within 10 meters) become whole and clean.

cantrips.name: Light
cantrips.description: Create a shining bright light from a focus item. Illuminates a 10-meter radius and lasts one shift. Extinguishes if you reach 0 HP.

cantrips.name: Open/Close
cantrips.description: An unlocked door within 10 meters and line of sight opens or closes.

spells.name: Protector
spells.description: Protect a person or place (no larger than a person) against magic. You can cast this on yourself. The power level of all spells cast against the target is reduced by your power level of Protector. Can also reduce monster magical attack dice by one per power level.

spells.name: Dispel
spells.description: Cancel an ongoing spell with the same or lower power level. Dispel can also be used to break other magical effects, if the adventure or GM allows it.

spells.name: Anti-Magic
spells.description: Disrupt another mage as they cast a spell. This spell is reactive and breaks normal turn order but does not replace your action. Activate after the opponent's roll to succeed but before damage or other effects. If you succeed, reduce the target's power level by your Anti-Magic power level. If the result is zero or less, the target's spell has no effect. Can also reduce monster magical attack dice by one per power level.

spells.name: Power Transfer
spells.description: Drain WP from another humanoid creature, or transfer your WP to another. You can take or give up to twice the WP the spell cost (4 at power level 1, 8 at PL 2, 12 at PL 3). The WP spent casting are lost in the transfer. Cannot exceed your or target's max WP or go below zero. If the target resists, roll with bane.

spells.name: Seal
spells.description: Bind a spell to any inanimate object. Seal's power level determines the bound spell's power level. For cantrips, power level 1 suffices. You set the trigger condition. When triggered, the activating person's WP are used. If they cannot or will not spend WP, the spell doesn't activate. Can be combined with Charge or Permanence. Without Permanence, the seal is consumed on activation.

spells.name: Charge
spells.description: Transfer your WP to any inanimate object, which acts as a battery. Each power level lets you transfer up to 10 WP. Anyone in contact with the object can use its WP instead of their own. Charged WP dissipate after one shift unless combined with Permanence. Can be combined with Seal.

spells.name: Permanence
spells.description: Cast together with another spell to make it permanent. Costs the mage 1 WIL permanently (reducing max WP by 1). Permanence's power level must match the target spell's. Cannot be used on spells with immediate duration. When combined with Seal, the seal becomes permanent and its bound spell can activate repeatedly.

cantrips.name: Flower Trail
cantrips.description: Beautiful flowers grow where you walk. They wither after one shift.

cantrips.name: Hairstyle
cantrips.description: Change hair color, length, and style at will. In the right context, grants boon on Bluffing or Persuasion.

cantrips.name: Birdsong
cantrips.description: Beautiful birdsong surrounds you for 15 minutes. Grants boon on Awareness. Only works outdoors.

cantrips.name: Cook
cantrips.description: Automatically succeed at cooking (p.103) without rolling Bushcraft, and it happens immediately (one action).

cantrips.name: Tidy
cantrips.description: The room you are in becomes tidy. Dust and dirt vanish and things are put in order.

spells.name: Banish
spells.description: Deal 2d8 damage to demons and undead. Each additional power level increases damage by 1d8. Armor and natural protection have no effect; cannot be dodged or parried.

spells.name: Lightning
spells.description: Call down lightning from the sky, dealing 2d6 damage to the target. The lightning then chains to a random creature within 2 meters, dealing 2d4 damage. Each additional power level increases all damage dice by one. Metal armor provides no protection. Can be dodged/parried as a ranged attack; if successful, no further targets are hit. Costs double WP indoors.

spells.name: Heal
spells.description: Heal 2d6 HP on yourself or another living creature. Each additional power level heals an extra 1d6 HP.

spells.name: Ensnare
spells.description: The target is ensnared by roots and branches and cannot move. Breaking free requires an Evade roll: with boon at PL 1, normal at PL 2, with bane at PL 3. Each attempt is an action, one per round. Others can help. No effect on monsters.

spells.name: Speak with Animals
spells.description: Speak with a mammal or bird. You may ask a number of questions equal to the power level. The animal can tell what it has seen, heard, and smelled, but perceives the world differently — answers are often cryptic. Animals never lie.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.description: Call a powerful bolt of lightning dealing 2d8 damage. Chains to a second creature within 2m (2d6 damage) then a third (2d4 damage). Each additional power level increases all damage dice by one. Metal armor provides no protection. Can be dodged/parried as a ranged attack; if successful, no further targets are hit. Costs double WP indoors.

spells.name: Purge
spells.description: Exorcise a demon or undead, dealing 2d10 damage. Each additional power level increases damage by 1d10. Armor and natural protection have no effect; cannot be dodged or parried.

spells.name: Heal Wound
spells.description: Heal 2d8 HP and cure one non-permanent severe injury (optional rule, p.51) on yourself or another living creature. Each additional power level heals an extra 1d8 HP.

spells.name: Engulfing Forest
spells.description: Call upon forest spirits to grow thorny thickets and roots. The area counts as difficult terrain (p.44). All persons (not monsters) except you within the area when cast are ensnared. Breaking free requires Evade: with boon at PL 1, normal at PL 2, bane at PL 3. Each attempt is an action, one per round. Non-ensnared persons can help.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.description: Target must roll WIL to avoid falling into deep sleep for 15 minutes. GM rolls against max WP (if listed), reduced by 2 per level of Focused heroic ability; or against 10 if WP not listed. If WIL roll succeeds, target is still Dazed. At PL 1 target rolls with boon, PL 2 normal, PL 3 with bane. A sleeping person is very hard to wake but wakes if damaged. Only works on living persons, no effect on monsters.

spells.name: Restoration
spells.description: Heal 2d10 HP and cure a severe injury (even a permanent one, optional rule p.51) on yourself or another living creature. Each additional power level heals an extra 1d10 HP.

spells.name: Thunderbolt
spells.description: Call a mighty thunderbolt dealing 2d10 damage. Chains to up to three random creatures within 2m of each other: second takes 2d8, third takes 2d6, fourth takes 2d4. Each additional power level increases all damage dice by one. Metal armor provides no protection. Can be dodged/parried as a ranged attack; if successful, no further targets are hit. Costs double WP indoors.

spells.name: Resurrection
spells.description: Channel nature's forces to bring a dead person back to life — not as undead, but truly alive. Costs the mage 1 WIL permanently (reducing max WP by 1). Within the same shift: PL 1 suffices. Within one day: PL 2 required. Within one week: PL 3 required. Beyond one week, the body is too decayed. Only one attempt allowed — if it fails, the person is irrevocably dead. The resurrected person loses 1d3 levels in all CHA-based skills (minimum 3).

cantrips.name: Puff of Smoke
cantrips.description: A dramatic puff of smoke appears in front of you. Very popular for dramatic entrances. May grant boon on Sneaking (GM decides).

cantrips.name: Ignite
cantrips.description: Light or extinguish a candle, torch, or lantern within 10 meters.

cantrips.name: Heat/Chill
cantrips.description: Make the area within 10 meters comfortably warm or cool. Protects against cold (p.54) for one shift.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.description: Send a flame from your hand or focus to the target. Can be dodged or parried as a ranged attack. Deals 2d6 fire damage and ignites flammable objects. Each additional power level adds 1d6 damage, or creates another flame at a different target within range.

spells.name: Frost
spells.description: Drastically lower the temperature around you. All natural fires in the area are extinguished. All living creatures take 1d6 HP and 1d6 WP damage and become chilled (p.54) — cannot heal HP or WP until warmed. Humanoids (not monsters) are frozen solid and cannot move or act (not even reactively); each turn they may roll STR (not an action) to break free. Each additional power level increases radius by 4 meters. Water in the area freezes instantly into ice.

spells.name: Pillar
spells.description: Raise a 3-meter-high, 1-meter-wide stone pillar from the ground or stone floor. Anyone on that spot must pass Climb & Jump (not an action) or fall off. Under a low ceiling, a failed roll deals 2d6 crush damage instead. Each additional power level adds 3 meters of height, increasing potential fall damage (p.53).

spells.name: Shatter
spells.description: Break the invisible bonds holding matter together. Deal 2d10 damage to a non-living, non-magical object. Protection values give no protection. Each additional power level adds 1d10 damage.

spells.name: Gust of Wind
spells.description: Conjure a powerful gust of wind. All loose objects and human-sized or smaller creatures in the area are pushed 2d4 meters away and take equal crush damage. Against a swarm (p.83), deals 2d6 damage instead. Each additional power level increases damage dice by one. No effect on Large or Enormous monsters (p.83).

spells.name: Fire Blast
spells.description: Send a large ball of fire from your hand or focus to the target. Can be dodged or parried as a ranged attack. Deals 2d8 fire damage and ignites flammable objects. Each additional power level adds 1d8 damage, or creates another fire blast at a different target within range.

spells.name: Tidal Wave
spells.description: Conjure a powerful tidal wave from a water source within range. The area originates from the source, not from you. All loose objects and creatures in the area are pushed 2d6 meters from the source and take equal crush damage. Each additional power level increases damage dice by one.

spells.name: Stone Shield
spells.description: Instantly conjure a shield of stone that reduces incoming attack damage by 2d6. Each additional power level reduces damage by an extra 1d6. You can cast this when you know the attack hits but before the damage roll. Stacks with armor.

spells.name: Stonewall
spells.description: Raise a wall from the ground or stone floor. The wall is 1 meter thick, 2 meters high, and 3 meters wide. Each additional power level creates another section of the same size. Anyone on that spot must pass Climb & Jump (not an action) or fall off. Under a low ceiling, a failed roll deals 2d6 crush damage.

spells.name: Whirlwind
spells.description: Create an intense whirlwind around the mage. All loose objects and human-sized or smaller creatures are flung 2d4 meters away, take equal crush damage, and land prone. Each additional power level increases range by 4 meters and adds 1d4 damage. With bane on the roll, you can choose to fling a person to another spot within range, choosing whether they take damage and whether they land prone.

spells.name: Firebird
spells.description: Send a terrifying bird of fire from your hand or focus to the target. Can be dodged or parried as a ranged attack. Deals 2d10 fire damage and ignites flammable objects. Each additional power level adds 1d10 damage, or creates another firebird at a different target within range.

spells.name: Firestorm
spells.description: Create a vortex of fire around you. All targets within range take 2d6 fire damage. Each additional power level increases range by 4 meters and adds 1d6 damage.

spells.name: Gnome
spells.description: Summon an earth elemental shaped like a humanoid figure of grey-brown sand or clay. Counts as a monster in combat (p.84). Follows creator's command (free action), acts independently with own initiative, must stay within line of sight of the mage.

spells.name: Salamander
spells.description: Summon a fire elemental shaped like a flaming lizard-like figure of fire. Counts as a monster in combat (p.84). Follows creator's command (free action), acts independently with own initiative, must stay within line of sight of the mage.

spells.name: Sylph
spells.description: Summon a wind elemental shaped like a bird-formed storm cloud. Counts as a monster in combat (p.84). Follows creator's command (free action), acts independently with own initiative, must stay within line of sight of the mage.

spells.name: Undine
spells.description: Summon a water elemental shaped like a tidal wave whose crest forms a woman of water. Counts as a monster in combat (p.84). Follows creator's command (free action), acts independently with own initiative, must stay within line of sight of the mage.

cantrips.name: Slow Fall
cantrips.description: Slow a fall and land softly as a feather, regardless of height.

cantrips.name: Lock/Unlock
cantrips.description: Lock or unlock a non-magical lock you touch.

cantrips.name: Magic Stool
cantrips.description: Create an invisible round surface, about half a meter in diameter, hovering at sitting height. You can sit on it or stack things. Lasts until you leave the area.

spells.name: Farsight
spells.description: See and hear what happens at a location up to 1 kilometer away, as if you were there. You must either see the destination or have visited it before. Each additional power level multiplies range by 10 (10 km at PL 2, 100 km at PL 3). Cannot be used to see other dimensions.

spells.name: Power Fist
spells.description: Your unarmed attack damage increases by 1d6 per power level.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.description: Lift yourself, another person, or an object up to human size from the ground and let it float up to 6 meters in any direction, then land softly or fall (your choice). Each additional power level lets you lift it 2 more meters, or lift one additional person/object. Lifting an unwilling creature imposes bane on the roll.

spells.name: Longstrider
spells.description: Double the target's movement for the duration. You can cast this on yourself. Each additional power level lets you target one additional person.

spells.name: Stone Skin
spells.description: Target's skin becomes hard and grey, gaining armor value 4. Each additional power level increases armor by 2. If wearing armor, only the higher value counts.

spells.name: Divination
spells.description: Gain knowledge of past events at your current location, even those no one remembers. PL 1: one day back. PL 2: one year back. PL 3: centuries. Visions are often fragmentary and cryptic — GM decides exactly what you see.

spells.name: Enchant Weapon
spells.description: Enchant a weapon so that results 1-2 count as dragon rolls on attacks and parries. The weapon also counts as magical. Each additional power level increases the dragon roll range by 1 (1-3 at PL 2, 1-4 at PL 3).

spells.name: Mental Strike
spells.description: Project your mental force as a powerful physical push. Hurl the target 2d6 meters away from you and deal equal damage. Each additional power level adds 1d6.

spells.name: Telepathy
spells.description: Read another person's surface thoughts. Digging up deeper memories requires PL 2 or higher, depending on how recent the memory is. GM has final say. You can also send your own thoughts using this spell.

spells.name: Scrying
spells.description: Specify an object ('weapon', 'sword'), substance ('gold', 'air', 'water'), creature or creature type ('the mage Zot', 'undead', 'orcs'), or phenomenon ('magic'). The spell shows you the direction to the nearest occurrence within range. Each additional power level doubles the range (200m at PL 2, 400m at PL 3).

spells.name: Dominate
spells.description: Take total control of another person's actions. Make an opposed WIL roll. GM rolls against max WP (if listed), reduced by 2 per level of Focused heroic ability; or against 10 if WP not listed. At PL 1 you roll with bane, PL 2 normal, PL 3 with boon. If you win, the target must immediately perform one movement and action of your choosing (except WP-costing actions). Target loses their next turn. Target can still speak normally. No effect on monsters.

spells.name: Flight
spells.description: Grant yourself or another creature (up to human size) the ability to fly freely with movement value 6. At PL 2 movement doubles to 12, at PL 3 it doubles again to 24. The flyer ignores all obstacles and is not affected by terrain.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.description: Teleport yourself up to 100 meters. You must either see the destination or have visited it before. Each additional power level lets you bring one additional human-sized creature in contact with you, or double the range. Cannot be used to travel between dimensions.
